newsitem.title: USA: Chase Manhattan files $500 millon shelf.
newsitem.headline: Chase Manhattan files $500 millon shelf.

text.p: Two business trusts formed by Chase Manhattan Corp Tuesday filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $500 capital securities series B.
The trusts, known as Chase Capital II and Chase Capital III, will use the proceeds from the offering to invest in junior subordinated deferrable interest debentures of Chase Manhattan Corp.

Proceeds from the sale of the debentures will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include the repurchase or redemption of shares of its outstanding common and preferred stock, the filing said.
The capital securities, Series B, have a liquidation amount of $1,000 per capital security, the filing said.
Chase has become the largest banking institution in the U.S. with over $300 billion in assets and $20 billion in stockholders' equity.
